title: penstemon rupicola
intro: Penstemon rupicola, commonly known as Rocky Mountain Penstemon, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Plantaginaceae. It is a flowering plant native to the mountainous regions of North America, known for its vibrant purple flowers and slender stems. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to soothe wounds, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Penstemon rupicola include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions as an expectorant, antispasmodic, and antioxidant.
